basic_info.description: Welcome to 283 Dellbrook Avenue, a fully detached home nestled in the coveted neighborhood of Midtown Terrace. The home features generous light filled living room and dining room with hardwood floors and large windows to enjoy the forested views to the west.  Two spacious bedrooms with hardwood floors, one bathroom with separate tub and shower, and an eat-in kitchen, complete the main level of a 283 Dellbrook. This functional floorplan provides a great opportunity to renovate to your own style and tastes.  The garage level features a large bonus room, separate work bench, hook up for washer & dryer with wash basin, and parking for two cars. The central Midtown Terrace location allows easy access to several nearby neighborhoods, all while being surrounded by a wonderful urban forest.
